args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).

This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented behavior and the test expectations.

transcript.reasoning_content:
The issue is clear. The function imports ROUND_HALF_UP but uses it, while the docstring says ROUND_HALF_EVEN. The test expects banker's rounding: 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66.

Let me verify: ROUND_HALF_EVEN on 2.675 -> 2.68 (since 2.675 is actually 2.675000... in Decimal, exact). 2.675 rounds to 2.68 (half even: 7 is odd, rounds up). 2.665 -> 2.66 (6 is even, rounds down). Yes.

So fix: change ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Let me create a branch and commit the fix.
